title: Notifications
summary: the notification port for real: email through SendGrid, SMS through Twilio, push through Expo, behind NOTIFICATION_MODE=fake|real with console adapters, typed templates and one telemetry event per send
postScaffold: NOTIFICATION_MODE=fake by default: every send is a console line and nothing leaves the machine. Nothing is sent until you set NOTIFICATION_MODE=real plus SENDGRID_API_KEY, NOTIFICATION_FROM_EMAIL, SMS_ACCOUNT_SID, SMS_AUTH_TOKEN and SMS_FROM in .env (EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN only if the Expo project enforces one).
